name: Bearings
summary: Market research and competitor tracker with a year you drag from 2016 to a 2030 forecast
about: A complete market research and competitor tracking app for a company watching its market, shown with sample data for a made-up snacks maker in Pakistan and five rival brands. Drag the year and the market moves with it: bubbles glide between years, shares, ranks and a province map update, and a scenario slider bends the forecast. It also tracks shelf prices, shopper surveys and field notes, in a paper-map light theme and a night-map dark theme.
how: Drag the year handle on Overview or Regions (or use the arrow keys, or press Play). Bubbles move smoothly between years; forecast years are hatched.
Click a bubble or a legend name to trace that brand's path through the years.
Competitors shows each brand for the chosen year, with watch levels, strengths, notes and a side-by-side compare.
Market has segments over time and a scenario slider that changes the forecast everywhere.
Pricing tracks shelf prices per product. Run a price scan, and create alerts that fire when a rival's price crosses your line.
Consumers shows each brand's funnel and recommend score; Notes keeps tagged field notes you can pin, edit and delete.
